comparison.objective: Raise and align a pump baseplate using two wedges without excessive tilt.
comparison.physical_skill: Matched bimanual wedge driving and load/tilt control.
comparison.success_condition: Raise 15 mm onto both flat seats while never exceeding 2 degrees of tilt.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual force regulation, but this task tests synchronized continuous wedge motion under load, not mandrel stabilization, hammer impact, fracture, and fragment collection.
